assertion_independence: No unavoidable input-echo assertion found: fixture row IDs are read from separately written storage or transformed lookup results; large==small alone can pass for two empty results, so it is interpreted alongside instrumentation and the landing classification control.

findings.text: blocking: review_paths validates only review_meta.directory and ignores review_meta.complete; when an existing review store has no lookup index, writing one new review inserts only that review and explicitly records complete=0 at lines 459-472, yet the matching directory stamp makes the partial index usable, so older reviews disappear from producer-based record_for_review_run lookups and the fallback rebuild at review_records.py:1643 never runs; require complete=1 before selecting indexed paths and cover an existing-store/first-indexed-write case.

importer_comparison.note: Later commits change evidence only; final-head focused gate separately read.

item_verdicts.diff: The 23 commits from f6b67f0a31c3540f6292a43ac37a41834da0ca6b through d9b2e925b830ae133c7e8e8a608ea8074e7550f2 add writer-maintained ledger/review projections and runtime integration; reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:566 omits the writer's completeness check.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/test_hot_path_reads_only_live_runs.py:182 measures the 20/2000 ended populations, retirement and 2005-row history; the final gate, red station mutation, read-only live timings and sequential importer logs are recorded, with promotion coverage limited to idempotent completion.
item_verdicts.goal: The source live pointer declares an open-run index for station, promotion, landing and obligations; reckon/crew/open_run_index.py implements that selection but its review lookup can silently omit existing reviews.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md names all 23 commits and readable baseline_suite/after_suite logs; their actual summaries are 51 passed and 64 passed, both EXIT=0, and the separately inspected importer pair has zero added failing ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source live pointer grants reckon/crew, reckon/ledger.py, tests and the evidence fragment; all 22 changed paths are within those grants, including the three existing test edits authorized in resume-2-advice.txt.

justifications.durability: tests/test_hot_path_reads_only_live_runs.py:205 fails when station history traversal returns and its retirement/freshness assertions independently observe storage, but no added assertion covers the incomplete-review-index case at reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:459.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_hot_path_reads_only_live_runs.py:182 has independently observed ended-file opens and the recorded mutation fails at line 205, while line 174 confirms that its promotion arm exercises an already-promoted run.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/open_run_index.py follows context-managed SQLite and lazy-import idioms and descriptive naming, but its reader at line 566 does not honor the completeness metadata its writer establishes at line 459.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/open_run_index.py:566 accepts a partial review index as authoritative, so bounded runtime reads can lose reviews even though the open-population selection is integrated.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches and owner reads in reckon/ledger.py:1250 and reckon/crew/review_records.py:1605 show existing full-history indexes; the new selective open-population projection extends those owners through writer callbacks and their existing authoritative fallback readers.
justifications.scope_discipline: The 22-path diff matches the source live pointer's expanded grants and the existing test changes are specifically identified in manifest.md:existing_test_edits.
